learning_outcomes.text: Assimilate the application of basic methods, approaches, solutions, structures, and elementary base during the designing of the electrical supply complex for users of electrical power.

syllabus_topics: Designing of the electrical supply system on low voltage in a differentiated user (manufacture department, agricultural object)
Designing the electrical supply system of a business establishment
assessment_rules: The Course Project should be submitted and defended in front of the manager of the project.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
